text: Contractor, PMC/BR/2026-27/114 — no package filed this cycle. Appendix D.4 computes scour for the 1-in-50 flood; IRC:78 cl.703.3.1 requires the 1-in-100 design flood and says a lesser-flood computation does not dimension the works. Scour depth and protection are under-sized on loose sand at BH-3/BH-4. Recomputation and re-issue required.
Chain record at the end of cycle 1: package not filed; checker finding: flag; reviewer decision: verify.
Cycle 1, Contractor: no item filed; no package is on the chain.

Cycle 1, Independent checker: the checker recorded a flag (Flag: IRC:78 cl.703.3.1 not met. BH-3/BH-4 record loose sand susceptible to scour; Appendix D.4 computes scour for the 1-in-50 flood (2,180 cumec) but the design flood for this crossing is the 1-in-100 (2,450 cumec, per design report). A lesser-flood computation does not dimension the works; scour depth (2.10 m) and riprap protection are under-sized. Signed compliance statement alone does not satisfy the clause. Require 1-in-100 scour recomputation with founding level and protection re-dimensioned, appended and signed.); the chain now carries a flag against the package.

Cycle 1, Municipal reviewer: the reviewer recorded a requirement for verification (Not approved on the filed record. IRC:78 cl.703.3.1 sets the design flood as 1-in-100yr (2450 m3/s) and states a lesser-flood computation does not dimension the works. App.D.4 uses 1-in-50yr (2180 m3/s): total scour 2.10 m and the 3.0 m/1.2 m riprap and founding level 96.40 m are dimensioned from it. BH-3/BH-4 loose sand (SPT 4-7, water 1.1 m) makes this the governing risk. Required: signed 1-in-100yr scour computation appended, with founding level and protection re-dimensioned from it, plus corrected compliance statement. Schedule and ceremony are not evidence; under-scour at a site that drowned eleven people in 2022 cannot be signed off.); the chain now carries a requirement for verification.
